errors.busy: Something is already running; stop it first
errors.bad_url: Paste a link starting with https://
errors.bad_format: Unsupported format: upload MIDI, Guitar Pro or audio

practice.title: 🎧 Practice with listening
practice.subtitle: Plug in your guitar: it listens and tells you which note or chord you missed, skipped or played out of time.
practice.use_file_hint: Use a file (MIDI, Guitar Pro, audio)
practice.wait_hint: Waits until you play each note right
practice.transpose: Transpose (semitones added to what you play)
practice.simulate: Simulate with a recorded take (no guitar)
practice.save_preset: Remember these options for this song
practice.upload_or_demo: upload a song or load the demo
practice.no_songs_html: No songs yet. Upload a MIDI or Guitar Pro file exported from a tab (best), or an audio file. Or play one of the charts.
practice.demo_ready: Demo ready: it has planted mistakes. Since there's nothing to plug in, "Simulate with a recorded take" is selected under Advanced. Try Tempo mode at 90%.
practice.chart_hint: Play along with the metronome: one strum per chord is enough; filler strums don't count as mistakes.
practice.presets_files_only: Options are remembered for files; charts already carry their own
practice.waiting_first: Start whenever you want: the tempo syncs to your first note
practice.bars_ready: Ready: bars {{from}}–{{to}} at 70% with the trainer. Press Start.
practice.empty_title: What do you want to play?
practice.empty_text: Bring a MIDI or Guitar Pro file (best), an audio file, or start with something ready-made.
practice.demo_hint: a short riff with planted mistakes, no guitar needed

report.title: Result
report.nothing_played: You didn't play any note of the reference.
report.transpose_hint: Your take seems to be in another tuning. Try transposing by {{k}} semitones.

analyze.title: Analyze a take
analyze.subtitle: Upload or pick something you recorded and compare it note by note with the reference.
analyze.form_hint: More accurate than live: it transcribes your take with basic-pitch and aligns it with the reference even if you played at another tempo.
analyze.empty: Pick the reference and your take, then press Analyze.
analyze.listening: Listening to your take (basic-pitch). The first time takes a few seconds; after that it's cached.

tuner.title: Tuner
tuner.subtitle: Uses your interface or USB cable input, with the same detection as practice.
tuner.stop_practice: Stop practicing to use the tuner

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Your progress per song and the bars you struggle with the most.
history.pick: Pick a song to see your progress.
history.empty: No saved sessions yet. They're saved automatically when you practice or analyze a take.
history.practice_hint: Practice them slowly and let the trainer raise the speed.

settings.title: Audio settings
settings.subtitle: Pick the input, the channel and the metronome output, and calibrate the latency.
settings.calibrate_hint: You'll hear 4 clicks to catch the pulse and then 12 more. Hit the muted strings (a short pick stroke) right on every click. Use headphones.
settings.tip_level: Your level should be between −30 and −10 dB while playing. If it turns red, lower the gain.
settings.tip_clean: A clean signal (no distortion) works best; monitor your effects separately.
settings.tip_soft: If soft attacks aren't detected, raise the sensitivity or lower the noise gate.
settings.cal_few_hits: Not enough hits detected. Raise the gain or play harder, without distortion.
settings.gate_hint: Sounds below this line (yellow mark on the meter) are ignored. Keep it just above the hiss you see when you're not playing.
settings.sens_hint: Higher catches softer attacks; too high and it hears notes that aren't there.
settings.test_hint: Press Listen and play: the bar should reach the shaded zone and pass the yellow gate line.
settings.below_gate: Your playing is below the noise gate: lower the gate or raise the gain.

home.title: Shall we play a little?
home.no_streak: Start a streak: one exercise a day is enough.
home.q_chords_hint: strum and I'll tell you if it worked
home.nothing_yet_html: Nothing yet. Start with the course.

course.title: Course
course.subtitle: {{done}}/{{total}} lessons. Every exercise is passed by playing it: it listens and tells you whether it worked.
course.finished: You finished the course! 🎉 Keep going with the charts.

lesson.exercises_hint_html: Press Listen to me and play. You pass with the score shown.
lesson.find_video: Find a video you like for this lesson:
lesson.pin_label: Pin a video for this lesson (YouTube or any link)
lesson.open_chart: To hear the chart, open it in Charts.

chords.title: Chords
chords.subtitle_html: Click each string of the diagram to hear it. Check listens to you strum it and tells you which note was missing.
chords.posture_hint: Check your fingering with the camera
chords.not_heard: I didn't hear {{chord}}. Check the input in Settings and try again.

charts.title: Charts
charts.subtitle: Chords per bar to play with a metronome: it listens and flags every chord that didn't land or was out of time. Filler strums don't count as mistakes.

chart.help_html: One line per group of bars, separated by |. Two chords in a bar: C G. % repeats the previous one, - is a silent bar.
chart.headers_html: title, bpm, time (4/4, 3/4, 6/8), capo, strum (D down, U up, . rest; one slot per eighth note), level, note. Sections go in brackets: [Chorus].
chart.unknown_html: Unknown chords: {{chords}} — check the names in Chords.

tools.title: Tools
tools.tap_hint: Tap tempo: hit the button (or the space bar) in time, at least 3 times.
tools.drill_intro_html: One minute switching between two chords as fast as you can without muddying them: only the changes I heard sound clean count. The best way to unlock a tricky change.
tools.drill_go: Start with the one on the left.
tools.fretboard_hint: Click any position to hear it. The root is highlighted.

camera.title: Camera
camera.subtitle: Point the camera at the neck, mark where it is with 4 clicks and form the chord: it tells you which finger is right and which isn't. Everything runs on your computer; the video never leaves it.
camera.hold: Hold the shape for a second.
camera.now_strum: 🎧 Now strum it: check it by ear
camera.cal_nut_1: the nut on the 1st string (the thinnest)
camera.cal_nut_6: the nut on the 6th string (the thickest)
camera.not_clean: The shape was right, but it didn't sound clean. Make sure no finger is muting a string.
camera.calibrate_now: Now calibrate the neck: press «Calibrate the neck».
camera.no_permission: No camera permission. Enable it in your browser and try again.

setup.welcome_title: Let's get guitarr listening to you
setup.welcome_lead: Two minutes of setup and every exercise will be graded by what you actually play.
setup.welcome_1: Pick where your guitar comes in: an audio interface, a USB cable or the microphone.
setup.welcome_2: Check the level and tune up, string by string.
setup.welcome_3: Start your first lesson, a chord chart or the demo.
setup.input_title: Where does your guitar come in?
setup.input_lead: Choose the input and play a string: the bar should move and land in the shaded zone.
setup.no_inputs: No audio inputs found. Plug in your interface or cable and reload the page.
setup.channel_q: Which input is the guitar plugged into?
setup.meter_hint: Shaded zone = a good level while you play (−30 to −10 dB).
setup.no_guitar: No guitar at hand? Try the demo
setup.tune_lead: Play each open string, one at a time. Turn the peg until the needle sits in the green band.
setup.all_tuned: All six strings in tune. Ready!
setup.done_lead: guitarr now hears your guitar. Where do you want to start?
setup.later: You can change all this later in Settings.
setup.no_connection: Can't reach the listener. Is guitarr still running?
setup.too_loud: Too loud: lower the gain on your interface
setup.hearing: I hear something… play a single string
setup.too_quiet: Very quiet: raise the gain or play harder
setup.silence: Silence. Play a string (check the cable and the channel)
setup.play_string: Play a string and watch the bar
